title: No such option: --forwarded-allow-ips

### Commit to Help

- [X] I commit to help with one of those options 👆

### Example Code

```python
No such option: --forwarded-allow-ips
```


### Description

Hello,

On the documentation: https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/advanced/behind-a-proxy/ , it's mentionned that i should use 
```
fastapi run --forwarded-allow-ips="*"
```

However,  when i use this:
```
/app # fastapi run --forwarded-allow-ips='*'
Usage: fastapi run [OPTIONS] [PATH]
Try 'fastapi run --help' for help.
╭─ Error ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ No such option: --forwarded-allow-ips                                                                                                                                                                         │
╰───────────────────────────────────────────
````

Linux

answer.body:
Can't reproduce the issue.
Try upgrading `fastapi-cli` to the latest version. This option is supported starting from `0.0.10` (https://github.com/fastapi/fastapi-cli/pull/113)
